title: Agent Registry Primitive v1 (P44)
description: Schema for AgentEntry records in the append-only agent registry. Two-axis taxonomy: status (lifecycle) orthogonal to sender_class (autonomy classification). Enforces D5 (NO_AUTO_PROMOTION) on promotions via the lifecycle validation layer. Closes the roster-drift gap surfaced by WS-6: ROSTER.md and agent-roster.md are generated from this registry (WS-2/WS-3), and drift is detected by comparing registry state against the markdown rosters.

agent_id.description: Canonical bus identity. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, no parentheticals. Must match the bare canonical name enforced by identity.md.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was registered.

status.description: Lifecycle status axis. Transitions: candidate_pending -> active_bootstrap -> active; active -> active_aip (research lane); active -> dormant (outage); dormant -> active (recovery, K10); any -> retired; any -> superseded (requires superseded_by). retired and superseded are terminal.

sender_class.description: Autonomy classification axis, orthogonal to status. autonomous_llm: agents like devin, codex, hermes, pi. simulation_gated_service: code modules like purple/red/blue-team whose sender identity is valid only inside an enabled simulation. non_sender: candidate agents (agy, deepseek) and retired/superseded identities.

trust_class.description: Trust tier. owner: human operator only. trusted: full fleet member. medium_high: elevated but not full. medium: standard. low: limited. probationary: candidate/trial. none: retired/superseded/non-sender.

role.description: Short description of the agent's function.

default_model.description: Default model identifier per model-tier-policy.md. Empty for code modules and non-LLM agents.

guardrail_path.description: Relative path to the agent's guardrail file (e.g. rules/pi-guardrails.md). Empty if no guardrail file exists.

profile_path.description: Relative path to the agent's profile file (e.g. agents/pi.md). Empty if no profile file exists.

hosts.description: Hostnames where this agent may operate (e.g. anvil, hummbl_vps).

mesh_scope.description: Description of mesh reach (e.g. 'Anvil + Pixel 10 llama-server API').

promoted_at.description: When the agent was promoted to its current status.

superseded_by.description: agent_id that supersedes this one. Required when status is 'superseded'.

parent_id.description: agent_id of the predecessor for lineage tracking (e.g. agy supersedes gemini-cli).
